snippet.title: Hold The Line | Zombie Rush: Survival Cinematic Trailer
snippet.description:
// SECTOR 07: QUARANTINE BREACH //

The perimeter has fallen. A lone SWAT operative stands on the bridge to hold back an endless swarm of infected and massive mutated bosses. Lock, load, and survive the rush.

Zombie Rush: Survival is a fast-paced survival action game where positioning, firepower, and fast reflexes determine how long you stay alive against relentless hordes. Push through quarantine zones, eliminate threats, and fight your way to safety.

Search for "Zombie Rush: Survival" on Google Play and Web to play now.
